name: Accordion Gallery
description: Horizontal row of staggered image cards where the hovered card expands while the others fade, forming an accordion style gallery.
contents: Row of image cards with staggered vertical offsets
behavior: Hovered card expands its width and its image zooms slightly
Other cards fade while one is hovered
Card height switches between mobile and desktop values at 768px
Renders nothing until mounted on the client
editableByProps: Expanded and collapsed widths, card heights, transition speed, faded opacity

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the staggered vertical offsets of cards

fixed: Staggered offsets are hardcoded for the first 10 positions
Mobile card height is read from window width once at render
